title: Proposed collaboration on RIT1-related Noonan syndrome

sentences.text: Exploring a research collaboration on RIT1-related Noonan syndrome
We are writing to the Noonan Syndrome Foundation, and would also value the views of the Noonan Syndrome Association and the RASopathies Network.
RIT1-related Noonan syndrome is linked to gain of function.
PATRAS and the RASopathies Network contact registry include people with this condition, and a RASopathies clinical and genetic study is recruiting.
Several studies enrol by syndrome without naming RIT1: a biorepository, a cardiomyopathy natural history study and a MEK inhibitor trial are recruiting, and Baby MERIT is not yet recruiting.
Earlier Noonan and RASopathy trials were withdrawn, completed or terminated.
Off-label trametinib is contested: evidence is a single case report, and dedicated trials are still needed.
We would like to explore a jointly designed study on RIT1-related Noonan syndrome, shaped with your community from the start: [study question], [design], [sites].
Any participation would follow informed consent and ethics approval, and we would share what we learn with your community.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to a conversation about whether this idea is useful to the families you serve?
If so, we would value your view on how your community, registry or natural history work could take part, with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
Could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you, perhaps [proposed dates]?
With thanks and warm regards, [researcher name], [institution].
